Max Harper: Heads up — planning to spend 6 weeks in Portland (May 10–Jun 21). Do I need to update anything for WFH stipend or payroll?
People Ops - Anna: Thanks for flagging! Quick Qs: is this personal travel or a temporary homebase change? Any client work tied to that location? :thinking_face:
Max Harper: Personal writing retreat, still on the same product team, no client travel. Not changing legal homebase.
People Ops - Anna: Got it. For a temporary stay under 90 days we usually treat it as short-term remote. Stipend is typically prorated if you’re away >30 days from your declared homebase — but we can confirm. Can you confirm exact dates?
Max Harper: May 10–June 21 inclusive. That’s 43 days.
People Ops - Anna: OK that crosses the 30-day proration rule. We prorate the monthly WFH allowance by days away from homebase. If you normally get $200/mo, you'll get pro-rated for the month(s) with absence. Will you need equipment shipped or any additional support?
Max Harper: No equipment. Also want to check tax/payroll nexus — I don't want to create any residency issues for the company.
Sophie Tran: FYI from finance: 43 days in another US state typically doesn't create tax nexus for the company, but payroll withholding can vary by state if you update your home address in payroll. If you keep your homebase as-is in payroll, withholding stays the same.
Jamal Iqbal: If you plan to keep taking salary the same and not change legal address, fine. But if you change your W-4/home address we need to coordinate. Also watch for local city taxes (PDX has some rules).
People Ops - Anna: Action items for you, Max: 1) Fill the "Temporary Remote Location" form (link: https://go/redwood/hr/temp-remote) with dates and physical address. 2) Confirm you will NOT be changing your official payroll homebase. 3) We'll send prorated WFH stipend amounts and confirmation within 2 business days.
Max Harper: Done — submitted the form just now.
PayrollBot: Payroll task created: #PR-4729 for Max Harper — verify stipend proration and withholding flags. ETA 48h.
Sophie Tran: I'll review PR-4729 and post the prorated stipend calc here.
People Ops - Anna: Quick note on benefits — short temporary stays don't impact health insurance eligibility. If anything changes (longer than 6 months or change of legal residence) we loop benefits.
Max Harper: Awesome, thank you all. Appreciate the fast help :pray:
People Ops - Anna: No problem! We'll confirm numbers by EOD Thursday. If anything else pops up ping me or #people-ops.
